enchantment.arcane.arcane_ward.desc: Blunts magic, projectiles and sonic attacks.
enchantment.arcane.ink_bound.desc: The item slowly mends itself while carried.
enchantment.arcane.lumen_edge.desc: Struck foes glow, and cannot hide.
enchantment.arcane.lumen_step.desc: Light feet: faster stride and a higher step.
enchantment.arcane.page_turn.desc: Strike faster, as if turning pages.
enchantment.minecraft.bane_of_arthropods: More damage to spiders, bees, silverfish and endermites, and slows them.
enchantment.minecraft.binding_curse.desc: Once worn, it cannot be taken off.
enchantment.minecraft.blast_protection.d: Less damage from explosions and their knockback.
enchantment.minecraft.breach.desc: Mace hits ignore part of the target's armour.
enchantment.minecraft.channeling.desc: A thrown trident calls lightning during storms.
enchantment.minecraft.density.desc: Mace smash attacks hit harder the further you fall.
enchantment.minecraft.fire_protection.de: Less fire damage, and you burn for less time.
enchantment.minecraft.flame.desc: Arrows set their target on fire.
enchantment.minecraft.fortune.desc: More drops from ores and crops.
enchantment.minecraft.frost_walker.desc: Water freezes into ice beneath your feet.
enchantment.minecraft.impaling.desc: More damage to creatures of the sea.
enchantment.minecraft.infinity.desc: Shooting does not use up normal arrows.
enchantment.minecraft.knockback.desc: Hits push the target further away.
enchantment.minecraft.loyalty.desc: A thrown trident flies back to you.
enchantment.minecraft.lunge.desc: A spear thrust carries you forward with it.
enchantment.minecraft.mending.desc: Experience you collect repairs the item.
enchantment.minecraft.multishot.desc: The crossbow fires three arrows at once.
enchantment.minecraft.piercing.desc: Crossbow bolts pass through several targets.
enchantment.minecraft.projectile_protect: Less damage from arrows and other projectiles.
enchantment.minecraft.punch.desc: Arrows knock the target back further.
enchantment.minecraft.riptide.desc: A thrown trident launches you through water or rain.
enchantment.minecraft.silk_touch.desc: Blocks drop themselves instead of their usual loot.
enchantment.minecraft.soul_speed.desc: Run faster on soul sand and soul soil.
enchantment.minecraft.thorns.desc: Attackers are hurt when they hit you.
enchantment.minecraft.unbreaking.desc: The item loses durability more slowly.
enchantment.minecraft.vanishing_curse.de: The item vanishes when you die.
enchantment.minecraft.wind_burst.desc: A mace smash launches you back into the air.
